data.title: Belgravia Gardens
data.about:
Belgravia Gardens by Ellington Properties introduces modern living in the heart of Dubailand. Belgravia Gardens in Dubailand offers studio 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed for modern living. Comprised in four elegant towers, these residences feature open layouts, premium finishes, and smart home technology.

Located in the heart of Dubailand, Belgravia Gardens provides easy access to major highways, shopping, dining, and entertainment hubs. The community is surrounded by lush greenery, offering a serene yet connected lifestyle.

Residents can enjoy an array of premium amenities, including a serene lazy river, urban beach lounge, and shaded lap pool for relaxation. Fitness enthusiasts have access to a jogging track, outdoor fitness area, tennis and padel courts, and a half-basketball court. The clubhouse serves as a social hub with a co-working space, a cinema room, and wellness facilities such as a steam room, sauna, and Japanese-inspired ganbanyaku room.

location_tile.title: Prime Location in the Heart of Dubailand
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Belgravia Gardens is strategically located in Dubailand, one of Dubai's most sought-after destinations for vibrant living. This thriving community offers seamless connectivity to key areas, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and major highways. Surrounded by lush landscapes, entertainment hubs, and essential facilities, it provides residents with the perfect balance of urban convenience and serene retreat.

  • 5 Minutes to IMG World Of Adventure
  • 10 Minutes to Global Village 
  • 11 Minutes to Habtoor Polo Club
  • 12 Minutes to Al Barari
  • 12 Minutes to Academic City
  • 14 Minutes to Dubai Miracle Garden
  • 16 Minutes to Dubai Autodrome

more_info.answer: Belgravia Gardens offers a diverse range of residences, including studios, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 2-bedroom + study and 3-bedroom + study options. Each unit is designed with open-plan layouts, premium finishes, and smart home technology for a modern living experience.
more_info.question: What types of apartments are available at Belgravia Gardens?

more_info.answer: Residents of Belgravia Gardens can enjoy resort-style amenities, including an urban beach, lazy river, fitness studio, yoga & pilates studio, sauna, kids' play area, clubhouse pavilion, cinema room, sports courts (basketball, tennis, padel, squash), jogging track, co-working hub, BBQ area, dog park, mini-golf, and more. The community is designed to offer a balanced lifestyle with relaxation, fitness, and entertainment options.
